label: Stata: Send File to Stata
command: if command -v send-to-stata.sh &>/dev/null; then send-to-stata.sh --file-mode --file "$ZED_FILE"; else echo "Send-to-Stata not installed."; echo ""; echo "Sending code to Stata requires an additional tool that communicates with the Stata application."; echo ""; echo "Install with:"; echo "  macOS:   /bin/bash -c \"\$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbearak/zed-stata/main/tools/send-to-stata/install-macos.sh)\""; echo "  Windows: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbearak/zed-stata/main/tools/send-to-stata/install-windows.ps1 | iex"; echo ""; echo "Documentation: https://github.com/jbearak/zed-stata/tree/main/tools/send-to-stata"; exit 1; fi
